newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values fall, corn flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean values fall, corn flat.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis values were lower Thursday in response to softening export demand for soybeans, grain dealers said.
"It seemed like there was some interest in selling the market today (Thursday) so the offers came down," a Kansas City-based exporter said.
Wheat exporters were not surprised that Tunisia was said to have bought Argentine or European wheat because U.S. wheat holds a premium to other sellers.
Tunisia bought 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat for January and February shipment Thursday, trade sources said.
Egypt was also expected to tender in two days for 50,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat for January/February delivery. Exporters said it was highly unlikely that the business would go to the U.S.
